description: Fork of exp741 (bf16 unembedder, drifted +15 mb to 1.4022 vs exp737 v2's 1.3872). Bug fix: extend the autocast(bf16) wrap to cover both self.unembedder(x_resid) AND the F.cross_entropy call. In exp741 the cross_entropy ran outside autocast, on bf16 logits, at bf16 precision — log_softmax + NLL over 32768 classes at bf16 is the suspected source of drift. PyTorch autocast promotes cross_entropy to fp32 internally (fp32-promotion op list) so this fix restores the same numerical stability that vanilla exp738 has (its autocast wrap covers the full model.forward including cross_entropy). Compare to exp737 v2 = 1.3872. Expectation: ~0 drift.
